name: Media Default Image
description: provides a default image to replace missing/not-found images.
project_description:
Media Default Image is widget media that provide default image if it is not found.

 Features 
 Media default image, use default config image to replace non found image with full applied style.

 This Widget will unify one default image to all website you don't need to set Default Value Input of image on each field image.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module require media core.

 Supporting this Module 
 This module is supported by Reussir.fr
